summary: Iteration 2 covered the four new features + regression. Backend: 6/6 new pytest cases pass in /app/backend/tests/test_new_features.py — PATCH /api/contests/{id} (update+persist, 404, empty-body 400, non-admin 403); GET /api/winners (correct fields, NO user_mobile/mobile, sort-desc); GET /api/wallet/history (merges prize/payout/credit/debit with correct signs, sorted desc). Frontend Playwright covered: admin login → Contests → click new-contest-btn → dialog title 'Create contest' → create UI_TEST contest; click edit-contest-{id} → dialog title 'Edit contest' → fields prefilled (title/fee/prize match) → submit button labeled 'Save changes' → PATCH updates the row (fee=77, prize=999 verified in DOM). Payments tab entries-search with 'zzz_nomatch_utr' shows 'No entries found'; Users tab users-search 'zzz_nomatch_xyz' shows 'No users found'; live filter on '70000' narrows to 1 user row. User login → Contests tab shows winners-board with existing winner (Ram / IPL Final Fantasy / ₹1,250) and NO mobile number leaked; Wallet tab shows wallet-history component (empty state OK for user with no activity). Cleanup: deleted test contest.

issues: React console warning persists: 'Cannot update a component (BrowserRouter) while rendering a different component (Landing)'. Same as iteration_1; wrap navigate() in useEffect. Non-blocking.

action_items: (Optional) Fix Landing setState-in-render warning by moving navigate() into useEffect (carry-over from iteration_1).
critical_code_review_comments: PATCH /api/contests uses body.model_dump() then filters None — correct; also 400s on empty updates.
/api/winners projection is minimal and explicitly excludes user_mobile — verified no leakage in payload and DOM.
/api/wallet/history uses three async cursors then sorts in memory — fine for current scale but consider a Mongo aggregation $unionWith later if entries/wallet_logs grow large.
ContestsPanel.openEdit correctly stringifies numeric values into form state so Input receives strings — prevents NaN churn.
SearchBox filter uses lowercase substring matching across name/mobile/contest/UTR — case-insensitive works.
server.py is at ~683 lines (grew slightly); still recommend splitting into routers eventually.
seed_data_creation: Backend tests create/cleanup ephemeral TEST_* users and contests. Frontend test created and deleted UI_TEST_Contest_A. One residual test winner (Ram / IPL Final Fantasy / ₹1,250) already existed in DB from earlier flows; used to validate winners-board visibility.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Both feature suites (edit contest, wallet history, winners board, admin search boxes) are green. New pytest file /app/backend/tests/test_new_features.py plus existing /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py form the regression baseline. Only outstanding item is the cosmetic Landing setState-in-render warning that predates this iteration.
